methodology.observation_window_basis: The historical run followed the August 26 report and covered developments through its August 27 observation time.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing difficult-to-reverse capacity, regulatory, and deployment commitments.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution announcements.
methodology.repeat_policy: The August 26 subjects were screened out unless materially updated.

provenance.notes: The report's findings, source links, directional scores, and original observation timestamp were preserved. Canonical category IDs and complete eight-category assessments were normalized without inventing cross-event links.

findings.headline: AWS and NVIDIA commit to two million additional GPUs
findings.summary: AWS and NVIDIA announced plans to deploy two million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS infrastructure in 2027–2028, alongside Vera CPU infrastructure and secure U.S. government AI factories.
findings.why_it_matters: A multi-year physical-capacity commitment at hyperscale is stronger evidence of expected production demand than another model launch.
findings.trend_statement: AI investment is moving downstream into compute fleets, networking, government infrastructure, and robotics.

source_links.title: NVIDIA — AWS and NVIDIA infrastructure announcement

findings.headline: OpenAI's 3.2-GW Georgia power contract receives regulatory approval
findings.summary: Georgia Power announced regulatory approval of its agreement to supply OpenAI's Effingham County project, expected to require approximately 3,200 MW, with OpenAI funding infrastructure costs and providing flexible demand response.
findings.why_it_matters: Regulatory approval makes the utility-scale project materially firmer and places AI data centers inside long-term grid planning.
findings.trend_statement: Electricity and grid infrastructure are becoming a primary constraint on AI expansion.

findings.headline: FDA approves first-in-class RAS therapy for metastatic pancreatic cancer
findings.summary: The FDA approved Rasonque (daraxonrasib), a RAS GTPase-family inhibitor, for certain adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma after a randomized trial showed a substantial survival improvement.
findings.why_it_matters: A new targeted mechanism crossed the full development pipeline into commercial medicine for a historically difficult cancer and target family.
findings.trend_statement: Previously difficult oncogenic pathways are becoming directly druggable.

findings.headline: Lam Research begins construction on a major AI-chip R&D expansion
findings.summary: Lam Research broke ground on a 120,000-square-foot Oregon laboratory expected to increase cleanroom space at its Tualatin R&D center by more than 50%, the first physical milestone in a planned $3+ billion global lab expansion.
findings.why_it_matters: Capital investment at the semiconductor-equipment layer indicates expected persistent demand for process technology required by future chip generations.
findings.trend_statement: The AI capital cycle is propagating through semiconductor process-development infrastructure.

findings.headline: Biosidus brings additional biologics manufacturing capacity online
findings.summary: Biosidus announced that its new bioreactor plant was operational, increasing production capacity for complex biologic medicines and supporting international supply.
findings.why_it_matters: This was a production-capacity event backed by operating manufacturing and quality systems, not a preclinical or financing milestone.
findings.trend_statement: Biologics manufacturing capacity is diversifying geographically beyond traditional centers.
